194. An Unexpected Encounter (3)

- Also, one might interpret that you and Orgal of Kinzelo have different methods of resurrecting the Sun God. Therefore, I find it especially hard to believe what you've just said. The sect you belong to may advocate the idea of resurrecting the Sun God only after destroying this world entirely. Utilizing a blasphemous existence.
As soon as he heard Sheenu's words, Jin recalled the story he had told Sanna.
'Did I just overthink, or is it really possible for a person to do that kind of thing?'

According to Sheenu, Sanna held a more dangerous ideology than Rosabo of the past. Besides, a deity like Sheenu appeared in front of Jin and gave information about Sanna, implying that her abilities could be quite formidable.
"So you mean to use Zipfel's power to destroy the world until the gate of the demon realm is found?"
[Yes.]
"What is the reason for the Sun God's altar being in the demon realm? From the beginning, the fact that Orgal worships the Sun God, and is there any relationship between demons and the Sun God?"
[Technically, everything that exists in the world has a relationship with the Sun God. The beginnings of the world and life are all derived from the Sun God.]
"That's not the question I asked, wanting to hear such an uninteresting story. It seems to have a particularly deeper connection with the demon realm."

[Well, I don't exactly know when and how the demons were formed. However, the initial demons always longed to escape from the underground and enjoy life on the ground. Since light is the biggest factor symbolizing the surface, it would be natural for them to worship the Sun God, wouldn't it?]
Uncovering the relationship between demons and the Sun God wasn't a critical task at the moment. Jin decided not to interrogate Sheenu further as he can find out more gradually.

"Understood. Anyway, thanks to you, I now understand Sanna's purpose and need to consider how to respond. Helping you in itself is no different from helping you, so now please tell me who invaded your territory."
Sheenu didn't initially come here to negotiate.
That's what Jin judged. Sheenu is currently cornered and is trying to find a way out through him.
From Jin's perspective, this wasn't a bad thing at all. He had obtained new information about the demon realm, the Sun God, Sanna, and the various sects of the Sun God Church.
Of course, he will have to deal with Sheenu and Kelliark someday, but now was not the time. If he fought with Sheenu right now, the result would be mutual destruction.
[It's the priests of the Sun God Church.]
"Pretty predictable fellows. Thinking of Pai's ordeal, they seem to have been quite a handful even for you."
[Most of the priests of the Sun God Church are the deceased, heroes with past renown.]
"Resurrected old powerhouses, how tiresome."
[They all died harboring resentment or obsession. They were seduced by the promise that if the Sun God resurrects, they can obtain what they wished for and became priests.]

"You are one of the deities with particularly strong powers. You're saying that even you had a hard time with old heroes who were resurrected and are now serving as priests of the Sun God Church. Why doesn't Sanna release them directly into the world?"
[Their manifestations are limited. The priests are in a state of becoming a sort of deity. They need a contractor or a special event to manifest in the world.]
"It sounds like it's just a matter of time before the priests of the Sun God religion freely operate in this world."
[Once that happens, it would be the end of this world. Even if all the powerful forces joined together, like during the Demon God era, they couldn't stop it.]
"You sound weak."
[Jin Runcandel, how do you evaluate your brothers?]
Brothers.
That word did not refer to Runcandel's blood relatives.
"...The Royal Clan?"

[Among the priests I've met this time, many were from the old Royal Clan. There were even some who I believe were once warriors of God. If they appear in this world, wouldn't the result be inevitable destruction?]
The sense of trust given by the Seal of Fire hasn't changed. Jin's expression hardened momentarily, then he shrugged.
"You seem to have been through some tough battles and are now scared, Xinu. I don't know why the old Royal Clan is with the Sun God religion, but they won't destroy the world."
[I hope you can keep your word. Always be on guard against the Shaman. On the day the underworld opens, this world will no longer be as you knew it.]
"I'm hoping that you struggle like this until you disappear at just the right time. To put it another way, I hope you disappear at a time when it won't affect the resurgence of the Sun God religion."
Xinu did not respond. His manifested form began to blur, indicating he was preparing to leave.
Jin didn't try to stop him. Xinu had given all the information he could about Sanna.
Jin was curious why Xinu was disappearing, but Xinu would not have shared. He was there to share information about Sanna and the Sun God religion, not to expose his own weaknesses.
"Uh-ah."
Once Xinu had disappeared, Pie's voice could be heard again. Pie couldn't remember the conversation between Xinu and Jin.
"Looking at the atmosphere, it seems like the conversation went well. Thank you, Mr. Jin."
Whether it was the after-effects of the divine manifestation or not, Pie began to eat the food in front of him. Latree continued to serve him food, looking sorry for him.
"Thank you, I really enjoyed the meal! I should go now. Just to let you know in advance, it won't be helpful to follow me and find out where I'm going...."
Quikantel watched Pie, who was holding the food Latree had served as if it were a treasure, with a troubled expression.
"Goodbye, see you next time!"
Of course, his companions ignored Pie's words and started following him.
However, about ten minutes after Pie left, Bale returned and reported that they had lost him.
[I never lost sight of him, but he suddenly disappeared. It was as if he had suddenly teleported.]
"He seems to have been summoned to Xinu's territory. Good work, Bale."
First, Jin shared the information he had obtained from Pie and Xinu with Runcandel and Honka Island.
Here's your translated text:

"I have no knowledge about the underworld. It's not even mentioned in the texts left by the master, who claimed it existed underground. However, there were Histers who researched demons. It will be necessary to find and confirm their heritage."
From Honka Island, I heard about the 'Histers who studied demons'. It was a vague answer, but I couldn't tell if there might be a clue if I found their heritage.

"I think I've heard of the door to the underworld somewhere in the past. I can't remember clearly because my memory is not intact... I have a feeling that it was a problem that our clan and my people were aware of."
"Is that so?"

"Yes, Lord. It's not revealed in the events and records of a thousand years ago that we've found so far, but the Church of the Sun must have been active then. Orgal would have tried to resurrect the sun god, and Lokia would have tried to stop his plans. I just can't remember, but there must have been an event. Wait a moment. It seems that Alphen and Tasha have something to say."
"Lord, Chairman of the Law Enforcement Council."
"Yes, say something, Alphen."

"Listening to the conversation reminded me of something, so I asked the steward to communicate. I completely forgot about it, but during the Holy Kingdom Defense War, our biggest problem was finding the door to the underworld!"
"Just like my father said, Lord. I remember carrying out that task as well."
Leht, Alphen, and Tasha felt a strange sensation when they heard the information that 'the door to the underworld exists underground'.

It was the effect of history manipulation applied to the three of them. It was the result of the power of truth breaking the power of history manipulation and the destruction of some of the Tower of Stories. Like water seeping into a crack, the forgotten information was stimulating the three's memory.
"Keep talking."

"The biggest problem for us during the Holy Kingdom Defense War was stopping the demon's forces. No matter how many we killed, they kept coming back, and sometimes demons we thought were already dead reappeared."
"Did the dead rise again then, like in the Hunsinjeon?"

"We thought so at first. But they were actually not dead. Some high-ranking demons were fighting by sending out their avatars while their main bodies were in the underworld. After realizing that, we were even more desperate to find the location of the underworld. If we couldn't find it, we would be the ones to fall first."

Alphen was gritting his teeth, remembering the harsh memories of that time that were becoming clearer. If there was a Hunsinjeon in the present, it was the Holy Kingdom Defense War that brought the world to the brink of destruction back then.
"Did you find the location of the underworld at the time?"

"No... We couldn't find it in the end. After defeating the demon lords summoned by the Witch Heluram, I died, and after that, Tasha took over all the tasks I was in charge of. Tasha, do you remember anything?"

At that time, Tasha dealt with the remnants of the demons after Alphen's death. Although it's just remnants, there were not a few demons equivalent to the Demon King among them, so she also died at a young age.

"After you died... about 2 or 3 years later, I remember finding a region where the door to the underworld was suspected to exist. I discovered it myself by tracking a demon with the Black Knights of our family. That location is... ugh."

Over the communication device, Tasha suddenly grabbed her forehead. She felt an intense headache due to the sudden influx of memories. Her comrades held their breath and waited for Tasha's next story.
Soon, Tasha calmed down and said,
"...The capital of the Holy Kingdom Vankella... Yes, Oterium. The land suspected to be the underworld was definitely the capital of the Holy Kingdom Vankella."
